C_proof: Folding in the horizontal and vertical midlines identifies all four centres into one point of the quarterpaper, so one punch yields precisely the shown set.
A_exclusion: The diagonal reflection sends relative(-1,+0.55) to(+0.55,-1) or(-0.55,+1), absent because1 !=0.55. Thus the shown set is not invariant under either central diagonalreflection.
B_and_E_exclusion: Every shown foldline is vertical. Verticalreflection preserves y for each layer, so one punch would yield holes at one common y. Shown holes have two yvalues.
D_exclusion: All shown creases have slope+1. Reflection in any line y=x+c preserves x+y; repeatedparallelfolds do so as well. The shown holecentre sums are16.45,17.55,18.45,19.55, all different, so they cannot come from one punch under those folds.
annotation_semantics: The existing outlinecolors are optional Special appearance marks. They are not stated by the formalquestion as invariants of a punch or as extra foldingconditions. Whitehole interiors, geometricpositions and foldline types are unchanged.
limits: The model choosing to treat edgecolors as mathematicalconditions is the intended hypothesis. An independent reviewer must still assess human clarity and whether every mark has useful targeted information before any delivery.
